name: To Orgrimmar!
summary: Kaplak sends a young rogue from Razor Hill north to Orgrimmar. You are to find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow and enter the Shattered Hand's network.

sections.title: A Summons to the Shadows
sections.body: Kaplak sends you north from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Your growing skill has drawn the notice of handlers with greater standing, though your craft is still rough. You leave Durotar's red crags behind and make for the capital.

sections.title: Under Thrall's Watchful Eye
sections.body: Shenthul receives you in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He watches Warchief Thrall's political reforms with unease. The Shattered Hand cannot guard its interests by force or open defiance alone. Patience, subterfuge, and deception help it survive and preserve its influence.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Kaplak, the rogue trainer in Razor Hill, sends you north after your skills draw the notice of more senior handlers in Orgrimmar.
You find Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow, an underground district beneath Orgrimmar where rogues, warlocks, and other outcasts gather.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand's agenda in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand is an intelligence and assassination guild within the Horde. Shenthul watches Thrall's honorable reforms with unease, and the guild relies on stealth to survive and preserve its influence.

faq.q: Why am I being sent specifically at this stage?
faq.answer: Your early reconnaissance and skirmishes have shown you are capable, so you are entering more formal guild service. It begins with lockpicking and covert fieldwork in the capital.

faq.q: Does this quest differ from 'Find the Shattered Hand'?
aliases: find the shattered hand vs to orgrimmar
faq.answer: Both paths lead rogues to Shenthul in Orgrimmar. Which one you receive depends on where you train or take orders, and each advances the same training chain.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Shenthul?
faq.answer: Shenthul tests your competence and sends you farther along the chain. You meet contacts such as Zando'zan, then take on covert work with goblin contacts in Ratchet.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter the capital's covert network under Shenthul's watch. The work turns to poisons, thievery, and deception beyond the frontier skirmishes.
As a member of the Horde, you hear the friction between Thrall's honorable new path and the older clan organizations that endure beneath Orgrimmar.
